rows.note: Use 副主席 as the general organizational title when the president is called 主席.

example.english: Mrs. Lee was elected vice president of the chamber of commerce, and she will take over if the president's post becomes vacant.
example.traditional: 李太當選商會副主席，主席出缺時由佢暫代。
example.jyutping: lei5 taai3 dong1 syun2 soeng1 wui2 fu3 zyu2 zik6 zyu2 zik6 ceot1 kyut3 si4 jau4 keoi5 zaam6 doi6

rows.note: Use 副總統 for the deputy head of a country whose head is a 總統.

example.english: The United States vice president carried out the president's duties while the president was abroad.
example.traditional: 美國副總統喺總統出訪期間代行職務。
example.jyutping: mei5 gwok3 fu3 zung2 tung2 hai2 zung2 tung2 ceot1 fong2 kei4 gaan1 doi6 hang4 zik1 mou6

rows.note: Use 副總裁 for a corporate vice president or senior business executive.

example.english: Ming was promoted to vice president of the company and now oversees its business in Asia.
example.traditional: 阿明升咗做公司副總裁，負責亞洲區業務。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 sing1 zo2 zou6 gung1 si1 fu3 zung2 coi4 fu6 zaak3 aa3 zau1 keoi1 jip6 mou6
